ticker_news.title: A Once-in-a-Lifetime Market Opportunity: Is Alphabet or Microsoft Winning the Quantum Computing Race?
ticker_news.description: Alphabet and Microsoft are both making significant breakthroughs in quantum computing, but it's too early to determine which company has the clear advantage. Both companies have dominant offerings in their respective fields and are major players in the AI race, but Alphabet may be the better buy based on its current business valuation.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

SPY.title: Federal Reserve's Preferred Inflation Gauge Marks First Slowdown In 4 Months
SPY.description: The Federal Reserve's key inflation measure, the Personal Consumption Expenditures price index, grew by 2.5% in January 2025, marking its first slowdown in four months. Core PCE, excluding food and energy, increased 2.6% from the same period last year.
SPY.author: Erica Kollmann
